Varterm TTS
https://varterm.com

Summary:
- Text to speech for web, Cursor, VS Code, and Chrome workflows.
- Long-form support with chunked playback.
- Markdown cleanup for AI/chat output, docs, and READMEs.

Key pages:
- Home: https://varterm.com/
- Long form TTS: https://varterm.com/long-form-tts
- Markdown to speech: https://varterm.com/markdown-to-speech

Developer/API:
- OpenAPI schema: https://varterm.com/openapi.json
- Edge TTS voices endpoint: https://varterm.com/api/edge-tts

Extensions:
- VS Code / Cursor extension: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=varterm.varterm-cursor
- Chrome extension info: https://github.com/cntrlne/varterm
